# DropSpace v0.2.0 — Smart drag and one Dynamic Island

<!-- update-summary: Smart drag now wakes one Dynamic Island without a permanent top-edge target while idle. This Stable release also unifies the interface, refreshes the final logo, and hardens official update metadata. -->

DropSpace v0.2.0 promotes the field-confirmed Smart drag architecture and the single-Dynamic-Island interface to Stable. It keeps all content local, preserves the existing Temporary Space and Clipboard History data model, and ships through the same verified installer upgrade path.

Official website: https://airanluo-dot.github.io/DropSpace/

## Smart drag, now Stable

- The default Smart mode watches bounded Explorer/Desktop accessibility drag signals and system drag thresholds without leaving a permanent top-edge OLE or hit-test window while idle.
- A temporary Dynamic Island appears on the active drag monitor; actual acceptance still requires a valid `CF_HDROP` drop and uses the existing Temporary Space pipeline.
- Cancellation, pointer release, accessibility completion, OLE completion, and the bounded watchdog converge on the same safe session cleanup.
- Classic top-edge compatibility and Disabled automatic wake remain available for unsupported drag sources; some third-party or virtual-file providers can still require the compatibility mode.
- The detector records only path-free signal categories and counts. It does not inject into Explorer, suppress input, alter Windows Drop Tray, or upload diagnostics.

## One Dynamic Island and final branding

- DropSpace now uses one rounded Dynamic Island for Compact, Drop Ready, Expanded, Dismissing, and full-screen restoration states.
- The former Notch display mode and its Settings selector are removed; older settings migrate safely by ignoring the retired field.
- The final true-alpha transparent logo is used across the App, taskbar, tray, installer, MSIX, Share identity, documentation, website, favicon, and social image surfaces.
- The official website retains the single green Stable indicator and the Compact, Drop Ready, and Expanded Dynamic Island showcase.

## Release and update reliability

- GitHub Pages is the single official website and versioned release API; GitHub Releases REST remains the App's validated fallback.
- Production website synchronization fails closed instead of redeploying stale fixture metadata.
- Release summaries derive from matching release notes, and CI rejects version or documentation mismatches.
- Publication verifies the GitHub Release, installer, portable EXE, MSIX, checksums, update manifest, official website API, and Stable website links end to end.
- Stable and Preview channels continue strict SemVer ordering without downgrade; Preview users can receive this newer Stable release.

## Downloads and compatibility

- **Recommended:** `DropSpaceSetup.exe` — per-user installation and verified in-place updates.
- **Portable:** `DropSpace.exe` — self-contained x64 executable; update installation remains user-managed.
- **Alternative:** `DropSpace-x64.msix` — unsigned package for appropriate test or managed environments.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` and `update-manifest.json` provide integrity metadata.

Requires Windows 11 build 26100 or later. These public artifacts are not commercially code-signed, so SmartScreen can show an unknown-app prompt. Download only from this official GitHub Release and verify the published SHA-256 values.
